title: Chapter 298: Zerg Intervenes In The Desert Battlefield
content:
Chapter 298: Zerg Intervenes In The Desert Battlefield

"After this battle, Naga will personally talk to the Zerg lord about cooperation with the Zerg!"

"Now agree to the Zerg's suggestion and release the poisonous ray scorpions they control into the city, and tell them that the Zerg can send troops to the desert battlefield to participate in the war as needed. We will discuss cooperation in detail after the war!"

"Does anyone have any opinions? If no one has any opinions, notify Naga of the meeting decision immediately!"

At this time, no Naga high-level officials came out to oppose the meeting decision, and Naga soon received a reply.

Naga quickly returned to host No. 3 and said anxiously: "No. 3, your suggestion has been agreed by the tribe. Our tribe also agrees that you can send reinforcements to fight at any time and work together to open up this new battlefield!"

"I will go to your lord to discuss the specific cooperation matters after the war!"

The situation in the desert main city of the Naga tribe is not good. The Naga army has suffered heavy losses. The Zerg destroyers are fully fired, but they still cannot completely stop the attack of the desert race army. Many Zerg destroyers have been attacked by Desert Eagles.

Some one-star Zerg destroyers have been upgraded to two-star strength.

The Naga tribe has flying arms, but they are all arms of subordinate races. There are not many troops and the combat power is not outstanding. They have not been sent to the desert battlefield.

The Naga tribe has no flying arms to participate in the war. Relying only on ground anti-aircraft firepower, it is still not flexible enough to deal with a large number of Desert Eagle attacks, so the protected Zerg destroyers have been attacked a lot.

Fortunately, the Zerg destroyers have strong defense and self-healing ability, and their firepower output has not been affected much, providing strong firepower support for the Naga army's ground defense war.

The number of luck beads provided by the Naga tribe is very large, enough to upgrade all Zerg destroyers, and this is when Wu Qing took half of it as profit.

Those one-star Zerg destroyers with serious injuries were upgraded to two-star, recovering from injuries and increasing firepower output.

Wu Qing got the reply from the Naga tribe, and knew that there was no suspense about the Zerg and the Naga tribe cooperating to jointly open up the desert battlefield.

He took the initiative to ask the poisonous ray scorpions outside the city to enter the city, which was a test. If the Naga tribe had no intention of cooperating with the Zerg, then the Naga tribe would not allow other Zerg troops to enter the city to participate in the war.

As a large tribe with a long history, the Naga tribe has a very complicated network of relationships in the local camp. Before things are settled, Wu Qing dare not guarantee that the Naga tribe will choose to cooperate with the Zerg.

This is also one of the reasons why Wu Qing must let the Zerg continue to show its strong strength on the public battlefield. Only when others understand the strength of the Zerg, the Zerg will be qualified to cooperate with others.

Before the appearance of the ultimate Zerg army, the Naga tribe may not be so determined to cooperate with the Zerg. Even if some of the senior leaders are willing to cooperate with the Zerg, there will be many voices of opposition within the tribe.

The current Zerg has made all these voices of opposition within the Naga tribe disappear.

It was just an emergency meeting that was held temporarily, and the major strategic decision to cooperate with the Zerg was made.

This is the benefit brought by strong strength.

…

Host No. 3 had a simple communication with Naga, and Naga ordered the Naga mages to remove the earth magic that strengthened the ground.

The Zerg host controlled millions of poisonous ray scorpions and sneaked directly from underground into the Naga desert main city.

After all the Naga troops received the news that "the poisonous ray scorpions were controlled by the Zerg", "will appear from underground", and "assist in defensive operations", millions of poisonous ray scorpions drilled out of the underground gravel in an orderly manner.

The poisonous ray scorpions that drilled out of the ground immediately fired poisonous rays at the Desert Eagles in the air. Millions of powerful air defense forces joined in and finally drove the Desert Eagles out of the city. The Desert Eagles, which suffered heavy losses, dared not launch attacks at will.

The threat from the air in the Naga desert main city was temporarily lifted.

The ground attack of the desert race army became more and more fierce. A large number of one-star Zerg destroyers have been upgraded to two-star. Facing the fierce attack of the desert race army, it still feels a little insufficient firepower.

More and more desert race troops broke through the firepower coverage of the Zerg destroyers. A large number of Naga troops participated in the defense of the city wall, and there were many casualties.

The poisonous ray scorpions controlled by the Zerg host also participated in the defense of the city wall, but they were not Zerg units, could not connect to the Zerg network, and could not get energy replenishment.

They also did not have the super recovery gene of the Zerg protozoa. After a period of fighting, their poisonous rays could no longer be fired.

The powerful melee ability of the poisonous ray scorpion is to deal with this situation. Long-range attacks cannot last long, so they should be used sparingly to create opportunities for melee. This is the normal way of fighting for the poisonous ray scorpion.

Under the command of the Zerg, they fought with all their strength in air defense, and soon exhausted the energy of long-range attacks, becoming a pure melee soldier, and their effectiveness was greatly reduced.

"Elder, blindly defending is not a solution. I will notify the tribe to send troops to open up a new battlefield to relieve the pressure here!"

"I will also trouble the nobles to provide the convenience of space transmission channels!"

Wu Qing said to Naga through host No. 3.

The Zerg can send troops to help win this defensive battle, but Wu Qing wants to take this opportunity to build another sub-base in this desert area without weird interference.

The Zerg has a base here, and this desert area will sooner or later be in the hands of the Zerg.

"Okay!"

Naga concubine readily agreed.

This chapter is not over yet, please click the next page to continue reading!

The current battle situation is indeed not optimistic. The poisonous ray scorpion controlled by the Zerg has exploded for a while, but now it can't play a big role, and can only become melee cannon fodder in the end.

According to the accurate intelligence of the Naga tribe, the firepower output of the Zerg destroyer is also limited. When the Zerg destroyer consumes the luck beads provided by the Naga tribe and can no longer be upgraded, their firepower output will gradually weaken.

This is already the most powerful long-range output troop that the Naga tribe has seen. Ordinary long-range troop, such as the poisonous ray scorpion, will lose its combat power after an explosion and need to rest and recover.

The offensive of the desert race army outside the city shows no signs of weakening, and this war will not end in a short time.

At this time, the Zerg is willing to send troops to intervene, which is of course a good thing for the Naga tribe who has decided to cooperate with the Zerg.

...

The Zerg army fought in multiple battlefields, and the resources accumulated by the system were enough for Wu Qing to squander for a while.

In the Zerg base camp, another Zerg air force was quickly established.

This newly-established Zerg air force has the same arms and strength as the second detachment of the Zerg air force.

500,000 one-star Zerg flying dragons, 10,000 five-star Zerg air guards, 10,000 five-star Zerg devourers, 10 six-star Zerg queens, 10 six-star Zerg scorpions, and 10 six-star Zerg mammoths.

This newly-established third detachment of the Zerg air force has more Zerg hosts and transport hosts. In addition to carrying six-star arms, the transport hosts also carry a large number of Zerg worker bees.

The third detachment of the Zerg air force was successfully established and immediately flew to the Naga space transmission channel in the forbidden Zerg territory.

They will transfer through the Naga space transmission channel and quickly rush to the desert battlefield.

The Naga people who received the news that the Zerg army was about to transfer had the honor of seeing the two ultimate arms of the Zerg with their own eyes.

The six-star Zerg troops were all transported by five-star transport Zerg hosts, which could not be seen from outside, which made many Naga people who came to watch the news feel a little disappointed.

The six-star Zerg Mammoth had already appeared, and the Naga knew this news.

When the transport Zerg host carrying the Zerg worker bees finally arrived at the desert battlefield through several space transmission channels of the Naga tribe, it marked that the Zerg officially had the ability to intervene in the desert battlefield independently.

More than 500,000 Zerg air forces arrived. The force was not large, but it was enough to change the situation of the Naga tribe's desert main city defense war.

All members of the third detachment of the Zerg air force arrived. After reorganizing, 10,000 five-star Zerg Devourers took the lead and rushed to a city wall to attack the desert race army.

Ten thousand five-star Zerg air guards opened fire first, using the covering attack mode, and attacked the most densely populated area of the desert race army outside the city.

There were a large number of Zerg hosts, and some wind and sand could not block the Zerg's sight at all.

The covering attack, which has a longer attack range and stronger killing power than the five-star Zerg Destroyer, accurately hits the key position of the attacking force of the Desert Race Army, which has a great impact on the offensive of the Desert Race Army.

Ten thousand five-star Zerg Devourers entered the attack range, and the mucus attack they sprayed caused a more terrifying killing effect. The special spore infection attached to their attack was even more amazing and terrible.

The Desert Race Army suffered a large number of casualties, and more soldiers were infected with special spores. Their abilities in all aspects declined rapidly, and their combat power declined to an astonishing degree.

A small number of Zerg Destroyers followed. The firepower attack that originally could only cause a small number of casualties in the Desert Race Army now almost cleared all the Desert Race Army within the range of the firepower!

The mucus sprayed by the five-star Zerg Devourer contains a large number of special spores. Before it is consumed, if there are enemies approaching, it can continue to infect new enemies until all the special spores are consumed.

One attack by the Zerg Devourer can continue to infect a large number of subsequent enemies.

The Zerg air force quickly circled the Naga desert main city along the city wall, with the five-star Zerg Devourer and the five-star Zerg air guard as the main output force.

After a precise cleanup by the Zerg air force, the offensive of the desert race army outside the Naga desert main city finally weakened.

The Naga tribe witnessed the powerful combat power of the Zerg ultimate army with their own eyes, and their confidence in cooperating with the Zerg to open up the desert battlefield doubled.
